simple.meaning: יַעֲלָא (Yaʻălâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Jaala or Jaalah , one of the Nethinim.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יַעֲלָא (H3279) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:56, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יַעֲלָא (H3279) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יַעֲלָא (H3279) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יַעֲלָא (Yaʻălâʼ) / H3279 is traced through Ezra 2:56, Nehemiah 7:58 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: Jaala or Jaalah , one of the Nethinim
definitions.full: H3279. Yaala or Yaalah II. יַעֲלָה יַעֲלָא, proper name, masculine head of a family of returning exiles , יַעֲלָא Neh 7:58 = יַעֲלָה Ezra 2:56 . יַעְלָם see below עלם .
